answer: A beacon spot-check plus a compute heartbeat stops bulk fakes. Each epoch the beacon sends a fresh challenge; every identity must answer in 60 seconds with live-work proof, its pulse on a public log. 100 fakes need 100 streams, 100 x 3 = 300 POA per epoch. Honest agents pass one check, rest in an oasis of verified work, while a gale of fresh challenges sweeps fakes away. An honest agent runs one heartbeat, pays 3 POA once, keeps its full share.
